name: My First Alchemy Set
objectiveText: Bring 5 Empty Vials , 5 Silverleaf , and 5 Peacebloom to the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall . Empty Vial  ( 5 ) Peacebloom  ( 5 ) Silverleaf  ( 5 )

comments.body:
The quest giver is inside the big building that leads down to [b]The Deadmines[/b], hidden behind a corner to the right as you come in. This quest is only available to [b]Alliance Alchemists[/b]. Her identity isn't fully clear, but it would appear that she's Edwin VanCleef's daughter, [b]Vanessa VanCleef[/b].

If you arrive with the required herbs, vials and 3 [b]Murloc Eyes[/b] already on your person, you'll be granted a quick [b]840 XP[/b] total as well as other rewards, including a new [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=4597/recipe-minor-discolored-healing-potion]recipe[/url]. The full XP reward only starts diminishing once you reach level [b]16+[/b].
